title: hc-enterprise-kg
summary: A CLI tool that generates synthetic "digital twin" enterprise knowledge graphs (people, systems, vendors, compliance controls) from domain rules and scaling coefficients rather than learned statistical models. Its architecture decision record evaluates SDV's HMASynthesizer and Gaussian Copula approach for multi-table relational synthesis and explicitly rejects it in favor of a custom rule-based pipeline, citing SDV's table-count limits, tabular-only relationship model, need for training data, and BSL license incompatibility.
evidence: docs/adr/001-custom-synthetic-data-pipeline.md:43 'SDV (Synthetic Data Vault) 1.32.1 ... Gaussian Copula + HMA for multi-table relational data'
needs: No code evidence SDV is ever installed or invoked; ADR is purely a documented evaluation and rejection of it as a design option.
